title: Provider price table
description: The pricing metadata of one provider model profile (additive plan section 5, ADR-0025): a currency and, per billed unit, a price in integer micro-units per N units. The cost of using u units is ceil(u * micro_units / per_units), computed in integers and rounded up, so a pre-call estimate is always an upper bound and drives the hard stop; the actual cost reconciles after the call. There are no floats anywhere. The operator supplies the table (host).

currency.description: The operator currency every micro-unit amount below is in.

effective_on.description: The date the prices were read from the provider price list. A provider may change pricing: the table is re-read at the profile review interval.

source_url.description: The https page the prices were read from, or null.

prices.description: The price of each unit the provider bills. A unit with no entry has no known price: a request that uses it cannot be estimated and is not sent. A key can appear only once, so one unit cannot carry two prices.

price.description: micro_units of the operator currency per per_units units, for example 150000 micro-units per 1000000 toks_in. A price of 0 is a free unit.

per_units.description: How many units one price covers. At least 1.

micro_units.description: The price of per_units units, in micro-units of the currency.
